lead_raw_text:
The structure of CuAuTe₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—Cu₂Au₂Te₄—and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies Au centers in a tetrahedral environment with four Te neighbors, Cu centers with eight Te neighbors, and Te centers with three Au and three Cu neighbors. The Au-centered tetrahedra show corner- and edge-sharing, while Cu polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces with Au tetrahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
